scope: Original alpha 4b59ae7 and main bfb53ac before this conversation, compared with current first-principles candidate; full four AW v3 graphs and original 192 query manifests, not all producible targets.
protocol: For each dataset: original alpha, candidate, candidate, original main; fresh single-processor JVM per arm; one complete warmup then one formal pass. Old planner classes are byte-identical; each old branch has one formal sample per query, their shared implementation has two; candidate has two.
measurement: Planning-call time and cumulative planning-thread allocation only; excludes input normalization, graph construction, and independent replay. Allocation is not peak heap, retained memory, or RSS.
